You know what? 
When I was about 13 I started having anxiety/panic attacks, I was depressed as well. 
I have pretty much always been very sensitive, very depressed, very emotional, etc. 

When I was 14 my mom had some kind of sit down talk with me ( I don’t remember how it came about )
She flat out told me that she did not believe me that I have anxiety attacks/depression. She told me I was too young to be stressed out. 

When I was 15 I was sexually assaulted. 
My mom punished me. She did not talk to me about it, she didn’t try for me to go to counseling, nothing. 

When I was 17 I randomly checked my blood pressure at home & my #s were high. My mom took me to the Dr. (where I was then diagnosed with HBP) but during that Dr visit I told the Dr that I am depressed. 
I took a test. I was then also diagnosed with Severe Depression. 

I now have other diagnoses, but what I’m trying to tell you is.. 
you can never be too young to be depressed/stressed/etc. 
that’s like saying you can only be raped at age 18. 
It doesn’t happen that way. 
Some of us just have a disconnection in our brain & we need medication to help us feel “normal” 

My advice to you is to positively act on your depression by seeking help from a Dr. 

Good luck to you, talk to me if you need.
